images.title: Guess and true angle
images.purpose: Show a guess of 39° beside the true angle of 49° so the gap of 10° is the score.
images.composition: One angle fan centred with the equation line centred below.
images.exact_structure: From one vertex, a horizontal base ray in grey #6B7280. A dashed grey #6B7280 ray at exactly 39° and a solid teal #0072B2 ray at exactly 49°. The thin gap between the two rays is filled reddish purple #CC79A7. Exactly 3 rays, 1 gap.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
the gap drawn larger than 10° compared with 49°
images.takeaway: The score is the gap between guess and true angle.
images.description: Three rays from one vertex: a base, a dashed guess ray at 39° and a solid true ray at 49°, with the 10° gap shaded.
images.context: Shown with the concept as its one key picture, next to the walkthrough video. PLACEHOLDER: specified, not generated yet.
images.teaching_notes: Ask the student to point at the gap and say what number of points it scores.

image_decisions.why: The idea is a picture of the angle itself; one clean image carries it.
